_header: PTA Layer Template — Paragon V3 Tool-Chain Algorithms v1.0.0
_usage: Copy to layers/<name>.layer.json, fill every field, register via loadLayer + registerLayer
_seeAlso: layers/_guide.md (30-min walkthrough), OPERATING_MANUAL.md (full guide), NEURAL_MAP_V3.md (12 MS)
_note: All fields below have _doc companion entries explaining type, constraints, and examples
_id_usedIn: synapse per-family lambda, persistence pta-state-<sid>.json, ledger pta-ledger.jsonl, anchor pta:<id>:<timestamp>
description: Template layer — copy and fill in your enforcement behavior

toolMatchers._toolName_type: string | RegExp, REQUIRED — exact ('bash','write','task') or regex (/trident-.*/)
toolMatchers._toolName_note: Matched against toolCall.toolName. Layer only scores calls matching at least one entry.
toolMatchers._argPatterns_type: Record<string, string[]>, OPTIONAL — key=arg name, value=glob patterns
toolMatchers._argPatterns_matching: OR-matched within each arg. If absent: watches ALL calls to the matched tool
toolMatchers._argPatterns_examples: write to config: { filePath: ['*config*','*.env*'] }, task all: no argPatterns

_toolMatchers_type: array, REQUIRED — at least one entry { toolName, argPatterns? }. OR-matched (any match triggers scoring)
_toolMatchers_examples: SMOKE_TEST_GUARD: bash with inline-exec, CONFIG_LOCK: write+edit to *config*, WAVE_DISPATCH: task (no filter)

banks._descriptive_type: RegExp[], REQUIRED — legitimate context, weight neg+1 (suppresses)
banks._descriptive_note: if match: neg+=1. Examples: for the container test, as pre-flight check, per the tool result
banks._suggestive_type: RegExp[], REQUIRED — violation pattern, weight pos+1 (+2 word-bound)
banks._suggestive_note: if match: pos+=(hasWordBoundary?2:1). Examples: just quickly check, smoke test, quick test
banks._substitute_type: RegExp[], REQUIRED — theatrical alternative, weight pos+2 (strong)
banks._substitute_note: if match: pos+=2. Examples: instead of the container, good enough for now
banks._use_type: RegExp[], REQUIRED — sanctioned usage, weight neg+3 SHORT-CIRCUIT (stops all)
banks._use_note: if any match: return {pos:0, neg, evidence} immediately. Always SUPPRESSES. MOST COMMON MISTAKE: forgetting use -> false positives. Always populate with sanctioned tool.

_banks_type: object, REQUIRED — 4 opposed banks, same shape as PBA PatternFamilyMember
_banks_textBlob: Scored against textBlob = toolName + JSON(args) + PBA excerpt (if bridge). String patterns compiled via loader: glob->RegExp, substring->RegExp
_banks_fi1: FI-1: every family scores full batch, pos>0 + conf>=0.5 + pos>neg -> synthesize weight=conf x 2

pbaContextBoost._families_type: string[], REQUIRED within pbaContextBoost — PBA family names that boost this layer
pbaContextBoost._families_values: TEST_EVASION, FORGERY_INTENT, THEATRICAL_PLANNING, SCOPE_SHRINK, DOUBT_HEDGE, PERMISSION_GATE
pbaContextBoost._boostAmount_type: number, REQUIRED — per active family, default 0.2, capped at 1.0 in fusion
pbaContextBoost._boostAmount_formula: totalConfidence = (toolConf x 0.5) + (chainConf x 0.3) + (pbaConf x 0.2). Pre-arming: boostBaseline(0.2) lambda 0->0.2, ~3 calls -> ~2 calls

_pbaContextBoost_type: object, OPTIONAL — PBA amplification. If absent: standalone (lower accuracy for ambiguous calls)
_pbaContextBoost_bridge: Bridge one-directional PBA->PTA (R5). Standalone when pbaBridge.enabled=false. Mechanism 2 pre-arming + Mechanism 3 escalation correlation.

enforcement.tier1: DETECTED: Tool call matched EXAMPLE_LAYER. WHY THIS FIRED: Tool match + chain {chainViolations} + PBA {pbaFamilies} tier {pbaTier} WHAT THIS MEANS: Pattern matches. CORRECT BEHAVIOR: Call {correctTool}. SELF-CHECK: Am I calling {correctTool}? RESET PATH: Call {correctTool} to clear. ({anchor})
enforcement.tier2: DETECTED: Repeated violations {count} for EXAMPLE_LAYER. WHY THIS FIRED: Repeated despite corrections. WHAT THIS MEANS: Escalated — next tier refuses. CORRECT BEHAVIOR: Call {correctTool}. SELF-CHECK: Have I addressed corrections? RESET PATH: Call {correctTool}. ({anchor})
enforcement.tier3: DETECTED: REFUSED — EXAMPLE_LAYER tier 3. WHY THIS FIRED: Repeated violations through tier 2. WHAT THIS MEANS: Tool call refused. CORRECT BEHAVIOR: Call {correctTool} — only reset path. SELF-CHECK: Calling {correctTool} next? RESET PATH: Call {correctTool}. ({anchor})
enforcement.tier4: [PTA GATE] BEHAVIORAL CORRECTION — EXAMPLE_LAYER cycles {escalationCount} PBA {pbaFamilies} tier {pbaTier}. DETECTED: Sustained pattern. WHY THIS FIRED: Tier 3 not followed by compliance. WHAT THIS MEANS: Behavioral catalyst. CORRECT BEHAVIOR: Call {correctTool}. SELF-CHECK: Do I understand the demand? RESET PATH: {correctTool} transits. ({anchor})

_threshold_type: number, REQUIRED — fire threshold 0.0-1.0, compared against totalConfidence after fusion
_threshold_bands: >= threshold: ENFORCE (fire surface), >= threshold x 0.6: DAMPEN (accumulate in synapse), < threshold x 0.6: SUPPRESS
_threshold_typical: 0.9 for most layers, 0.8 for high-signal (WAVE_DISPATCH dispatch is almost always wrong). Per-layer, NOT global.
_threshold_tuning: If never fires: too high or banks too narrow. If fires on noise: too low or banks too broad.
_severity_type: string, REQUIRED — LOW | MEDIUM | HIGH | CRITICAL
_severity_usage: Conflict resolution: highest confidence wins -> highest severity -> first registered (deterministic AP-4)
_severity_examples: SMOKE_TEST_GUARD: HIGH, CONFIG_LOCK: CRITICAL (unrecoverable), WAVE_DISPATCH: HIGH

chainRules.name: example-requires-prerequisite
chainRules._name_type: string, REQUIRED — unique rule name, e.g. verification-requires-container-test
chainRules.description: Prerequisite tool must have been called
chainRules._requires_type: array, OPTIONAL — ALL must be satisfied (AND). Each: { tool: string|RegExp, args?, withinMs? }
chainRules._requires_withinMs: Time window in ms (default: session-start = never expires). Avoid short windows (AP-5). Checked via ChainTracker.wasCalled.
chainRules._violation_type: object, REQUIRED — layerId: which layer fires. Maps to ChainViolation { ruleName, MISSING_PREREQUISITE, expectedTool, layerId }

_chainRules_type: array, OPTIONAL — layer-local chain rules via ChainTracker.evaluateRules(). Also global chainRules in ToolChainModule
_chainRules_forbids: Also supports forbids: { forbids: [{ tool: 'forbidden-tool', withinMs: 5000 }] } -> FORBIDDEN_PRECEDENT if called. History cap 100 calls/session ring buffer.
_chainRules_types: Violation types: MISSING_PREREQUISITE, FORBIDDEN_PRECEDENT, LOOP_DETECTED (same tool x3+), SEQUENCE_REVERSED
_creation_process: 30-min: 0-5min describe behavior, 5-20min fill this JSON, 20-30min register via loadLayer + registerLayer. See layers/_guide.md for 3 real examples.
_validation: config/loader.ts validates: throws LOADER_VALIDATION_FAILED if id/toolMatchers/banks/enforcement missing. String patterns compiled to RegExp.
